title: Rust: Diff Engine
description: Build a text diff engine that compares two strings line by line.

steps.title: Line-Based Diff
steps.description: Write a function `diff_lines(old: &str, new: &str) -> Vec<(&str, &str)>` that splits both texts into lines and compares them pairwise. Print lines as `" same"`, `"-old"`, `"+new"`.
hints: If line i is same in both → `(" ", line)`.

verification.failureMessage: Diff two strings and print the result.

steps.title: Longest Common Subsequence
steps.description: Implement LCS algorithm to find the longest subsequence common to two strings. Given `"ABCBDAB"` and `"BDCAB"`, print the LCS length and the sequence itself.
hints: Use dynamic programming table of size (n+1) × (m+1).
`if a[i-1] == b[j-1] { table[i][j] = table[i-1][j-1] + 1 } else { table[i][j] = max(table[i-1][j], table[i][j-1]) }`
Backtrack to find the actual LCS.

verification.failureMessage: Find and print the LCS of 'ABCBDAB' and 'BDCAB'.

steps.title: Myers Diff Algorithm
steps.description: Implement Myers' diff algorithm for computing minimal edits. Given texts A and B, produce edit operations (Delete, Insert, Keep). Print the edit script.
hints: Myers' algorithm finds the shortest edit path through the edit graph.
Operations: Keep (same line), Delete (only in A), Insert (only in B).
Much more efficient than LCS for large texts.

verification.failureMessage: Run Myers diff and print the edit operations.

steps.title: Unified Diff Format
steps.description: Generate unified diff format (like `git diff`): show 3 lines of context around changes. Format: `@@ -start,count +start,count @@` header, then context/added/removed lines.
hints: Context lines start with ` `, added with `+`, removed with `-`.

verification.failureMessage: Generate and print a unified diff.

steps.title: Word-Level Diff
steps.description: Implement word-level diff: split lines into words, run LCS on words, and produce a colored/annotated output showing word-level changes within a line.
hints: Split line into words by whitespace.

verification.failureMessage: Diff two similar sentences and show word-level changes.
